title: Cardiovascular disease risk assessment using a deep-learning-based retinal biomarker: a comparison with existing risk scores.
summary: A deep-learning retinal biomarker classified cardiovascular risk against established risk tools in two population cohorts; the source does not show treatment benefit.
ai_technology: deep-learning retinal biomarker Reti-CVD was compared with established risk-score groups in UK Biobank and Singapore SEED.
